stage: before hosted candidate measurement and release acceptance

additional_reproduced_work.finding: Owned synthetic packages in the working directory or PYTHONPATH shadowed the managed Unix launcher and version probe; ambient extras could falsely satisfy the extras check; invalid PYTHONHOME prevented startup.
additional_reproduced_work.change: Use isolated interpreter mode and explicit UTF-8 for installer children, bootstrap helpers, installed probes and managed launchers. Propagate isolation into newly generated MCP/service commands while retaining nonisolated source workflows and explicit unbuffered service output. Generate the Windows executable with the existing pip-vendored distlib interpreter_args facility and retain the existing atomic activation and ownership checks.
additional_reproduced_work.validation: Actual installed package smoke tests under poisoned Python environment and working directory on all three CI operating systems; preserve application and pip configuration variables, arguments and Unicode paths; verify failed staging preserves the previous launcher.

additional_reproduced_work.finding: The first real Windows CI passes read-only process probing but fails all three completed-tail update assertions. Windows path-stat and descriptor-stat ctime semantics can differ after file modification, causing unchanged-content snapshots to be deferred.
additional_reproduced_work.change: Compare ctime within the same stat API before and after reading, while retaining cross-API file identity, size and mtime checks and rejecting files changed during reading.
additional_reproduced_work.validation: Reproduce differing path/descriptor metadata in a deterministic regression and retain the original real Windows complete-tail output and counter assertions.
